description: Which placements of aggregates and grouping are accepted, with which rows and error numbers: an aggregate in WHERE, a bare column beside Count(*) with no GROUP BY, a select column not in the GROUP BY, HAVING with no GROUP BY (aggregate and plain column), HAVING on a non-grouped column, on a grouped column and on an output alias, an aggregate of an aggregate, an aggregate as a GROUP BY key, ORDER BY an aggregate absent from the select list and an alias, HAVING with a subquery and with Sum(v) Is Null, and WHERE plus HAVING together? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
